If you’d like a fast and safe way to buy Monopoly Go stickers, head on over to LootBar.gg! ## Artful Tales Sticker Season Overview. Welcome to Monopoly Go’s exciting new sticker season! This colorful sticker album series offers a fun way to beat the winter blues. This season features 17 standard sticker albums to collect. Plus, if you complete multiple collections, you can unlock five prestige albums for even more rewards. You can find stickers for these albums in all kinds of sticker packs. ## Artful Tales Albums and Rewards. If you manage to complete all 17 standard albums in Monopoly Go’s Artful Tales sticker season, you’ll unlock some fantastic rewards. Not only can you complete the albums a second time for another set of prizes (including the five prestige albums, which require even rarer stickers), but you’ll also earn some great bonuses.
